about.title: About Me
paragraphs: I'm Taira, a full-stack software engineer based in the U.S.

I work fully remote for a company in Japan, building features end to end — web, mobile, and AWS — on healthcare products used by care facilities across the country. I care about making things fast, secure, and reliable.
Outside work, I build my own tools with AI agents and a small home server — like the Spanish vocabulary trainer I use every day.
Before software, I co-founded a tutoring school and grew it to 56 students. It taught me to build with the people who use the product — and the business — in mind.

spanish-vocab.title: Spanish Vocabulary Trainer
spanish-vocab.summary: A five-minute daily trainer I built to say Spanish words, not just recognize them — the part my Duolingo routine was missing.
highlights: Spaced repetition with FSRS, the algorithm behind Anki
Mistake explanations come from the word list and conjugation tables, not an LLM — instant and always correct
A local LLM only drafts new entries; I review each one before it is added
spanish-vocab.imageAlt: Say it from scratch: 通り (street) → la calle
spanish-vocab.flowNote: A local LLM drafts new entries; I review them before they are added

juku-cloud.title: Juku Cloud
juku-cloud.summary: SaaS that standardizes sharing student traits and handoff notes for tutoring schools.
highlights: Manage student profiles and lesson handoffs in the cloud
Production architecture with ECS Fargate, RDS, and CloudFront
Automated testing and deployments via CI/CD
juku-cloud.flowNote: Tests and deploys run on GitHub Actions

qiita-x-automation.title: Automated Qiita & X Posting with GitHub Actions
qiita-x-automation.summary: Cron-based workflow that posts to Qiita and X automatically using GitHub Actions.
highlights: Supports both scheduled and manual triggers
Kept a year of daily posts going on Qiita (about 700 contributions)
Integrates the Qiita API with the X API
